dedupe_keys.name: aires d alimentation de captage metropole

description: Aires d'Alimentation de Captage - Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Office Français de la Biodiversité (OFB) - Information Géographique sur l'Eau. L’Aire d’Alimentation du Captage (AAC) est définie sur des bases hydrologiques ou hydrogéologiques. Elle correspond aux surfaces sur lesquelles l’eau qui s’infiltre ou ruisselle participe à l’alimentation de la ressource en eau dans laquelle se fait le prélèvement. Coverage: Office Français de la Biodiversité (OFB) - Information Géographique sur l'Eau. The publisher named on the listing is Office Français de la Biodiversité (OFB) - Information Géographique sur l'Eau. Its keywords include zonage, perimetre, politique-de-lenvironnement, donnees-ouvertes, france, eau-potable. The listing shows 6 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
